Here is the review of the provided Python code.

ISSUE: line 26 | Mutating the global DEFAULTS dictionary instead of creating a copy, causing state leakage between calls and allowing external modification of defaults.
ISSUE: line 17 | bool(value) always returns True for any non-empty string (e.g., "false", "0"), making it impossible to set boolean flags to False via environment variables.
ISSUE: line 51-54 | dump_config lacks atomicity guarantees on failure; if json.dump raises an exception, the temporary file is left behind, and if os.replace fails, the original file may be unchanged but the temp file remains (resource leak/clutter).
ISSUE: line 30 | No error handling for invalid JSON in the config file, which will cause an unhandled json.JSONDecodeError crash.
ISSUE: line 19 | No error handling for invalid integer strings in environment variables, which will cause an unhandled ValueError crash.
